m4pro-24gb.description: MacBook Pro, Apple M4 Pro 12C CPU / 16C GPU, 24 GB

m5pro-64gb.description: MacBook Pro, Apple M5 Pro, 64 GB (arrives 2026-11-20)

rtx5070ti-16gb.description: Desktop, NVIDIA RTX 5070 Ti 16 GB GDDR7

_notes.gpu_mem_budget_gb: Apple: iogpu.wired_limit_mb if raised (m4pro-24gb: 20480 MB = 21.4 GB), else macOS default of ~2/3 of RAM at 24 GB and ~3/4 at 64 GB. env.json records the value in effect. NVIDIA: VRAM minus display/driver overhead.
_notes.min_charger_w: suite.py refuses to measure below this. A 30 W charger let the M4 Pro drain 60% -> 9% under load while 'plugged in' and throttle ~40%. Apple ships 70 W+ with Pro laptops.
_notes.assumed_efficiency: Fraction of nominal used when results/<machine>/membw.json is missing. M4 Pro measured 260/273 = 0.95 on the MLX read kernel.
_notes.machine keys: Must match the results/<machine>/ slug, i.e. bench/env.py default_machine_slug() or the --machine flag.
